units.source_text: 这句话猛烈地刺伤了我，我羞得无地自容。

en.t: Those words wounded me fiercely, and I was so ashamed that I wanted to disappear.

units.source_text: 然而，我对姑娘感到的憎恶，

en.t: However, the hatred I felt toward the girl

units.source_text: 却伴随着一阵头晕目眩转变为一种突然的欲望，这是非常奇异的。

en.t: changed, along with a wave of dizziness, into a sudden desire, which was extremely strange.
